decision.description: withdrawn when the rebuttal defeats the premise the finding rested on, upheld when it does not, modified when the defect is real but differs from the original description.

reasoning.description: What in the code decides it. Name the file, the declaration, and the mechanism, so the conclusion can be checked without rerunning the review.

revised_finding.description: Present only when decision is modified. Null otherwise.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root.
